items.title: Donn Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 6, 2009

ctx.x: Well only the drummer. Only the drummer. Jimmy and Ronnie. They played all over the place. But then again when I had to hire somebody to get them to play with the band, they might have been from, you know, like Syracuse, from another band. And we had, and you may be familiar with these names, but we had a gig in Elmira and needed a piano and a bass player and Jimmy Wormworth was playing drums and so he said how about these
guys. And I said well who are they? And he said well it’s Ron Carter on bass and Gap Mangione on piano. Chuck Mangione’s brother.
